sentences.en: I rang a friend: "Long time no see — I've got something to tell you: I moved."
The new home is very close to the subway station — it only takes five minutes on foot.
Although the rent is a bit more expensive, the area is very convenient — there's a supermarket right downstairs.
My friend asked me: "When did you move? Why so suddenly?"
I said: "Last month — because the old place was too run-down, we decided to move out."
I gave her my new address and told her to come visit me on the weekend.
After finishing the call, I started tidying up the bookshelf in my room.

quiz.q: Where is the narrator's new home located?
Why did the narrator decide to move out of the old place?
a: The old house was too run-down

quiz.q: What does the narrator do after telling the friend the new address?
a: Invites her to visit on the weekend

grammar.p: 离 + place + 很近/远（distance from a place）
grammar.e: 离 marks the reference point when saying how close or far something is.
grammar.x: 新家离地铁站很近。— The new home is very close to the subway station.

grammar.e: 虽然 introduces a fact, and 但是 introduces the contrast that follows.
grammar.x: 虽然房租贵了一点，但是附近很方便。— Although the rent is a bit more, the area is very convenient.

grammar.p: 让 + someone + verb（to have/let someone do something）
grammar.e: 让 introduces the person and the action they are caused or allowed to do.
grammar.x: 我告诉她新地址，让她周末来我家玩。— I gave her my new address and told her to come visit on the weekend.
